# SGit Newsroom

From the editor Third edition. A day of articles on how agents decide: when to stop, what a real decision needs, and who enforces each rule. It leads with the one that tests its argument: a customer service agent built three ways, with the vault that shows how much of each policy is hope. Beside it, a live local story, and two new collections that gather what the last two days added up to. [The desk log →](../newsroom/log.md)
